build_args: blender -b --factory-startup -P build_c22.py -- <out dir> --fleet <dir with build_fleet.py's Catalina22_shape.blend>: reads <out>/c22.blend
note: The Catalina 22's rebuild (docs/c22-2 on). Slice 1 builds the hull shell (C22_Hull) and a placeholder deck (C22_DeckPlaceholder, replaced in slice 2); the keel and rudder are today's (Catalina22_Board, SM_Catalina22_Rudder from the fleet's shape .blend) until slice 3. Rules as in sections_j22.json: an entry ending in '_' or '*' is a name prefix, any other an exact name; unmatched is 'other' (the rig). The keel and rudder sections are filled only when build_c22.py runs with --fleet; without it the size check reports the draft as not measured.
joins_note: Slice 2 adds the hull-to-deck join at the sheer, slice 3 the keel trunk.
